svg.title: Two ways to search nestor
svg.desc: Story: planning a trip to Lisbon. First, semantic search: the question 'where did I want to eat?' finds 'dinner spots in Alfama', 'table at Ramiro, Friday' and 'pastry list for Belem', no word in common, closest first. Then deterministic search: the tag @@lisbon with the todo filter lists every task tagged lisbon, the same list every time.
